title: Cheap cart
text: Cheap cart. This cart is similar in size to other 3 tier carts of the same price range; however, the overall construction and quality of the cart is on the cheap side. The baskets seem like a dollar-tree grade container. The baskets also do not sit level, so the over all cart looks lopsided. I wouldn't trust putting stuff like a lotion bottle or a piggy bank on this because it might end up breaking.
